File: .github/workflows/pr-validate.yml
```yaml
name: PR Validation against Production

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  validate:
    name: Validate against Production
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 'lts/*'

      - name: Install Salesforce CLI
        run: npm install --global @salesforce/cli

      - name: Authenticate to Production
        env:
          SF_CONSUMER_KEY: ${{ secrets.SF_CONSUMER_KEY }}
          SF_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.SF_USERNAME }}
          SF_JWT_KEY: ${{ secrets.SF_JWT_KEY }}
        run: |
          KEY_FILE="$(mktemp)"
          chmod 600 "$KEY_FILE"
          printf '%s\n' "$SF_JWT_KEY" > "$KEY_FILE"
          sf org login jwt \
            --client-id "$SF_CONSUMER_KEY" \
            --jwt-key-file "$KEY_FILE" \
            --username "$SF_USERNAME" \
            --instance-url https://login.salesforce.com \
            --alias prod \
            --set-default
          rm -f "$KEY_FILE"

      - name: Validate Deployment against Production
        run: |
          mkdir -p test-results
          sf project deploy start \
            --source-dir force-app \
            --target-org prod \
            --dry-run \
            --test-level RunLocalTests \
            --wait 120 \
            --junit \
            --results-dir test-results

      - name: Upload Apex Test Results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: apex-test-results
          path: test-results/
          if-no-files-found: warn
```

In SOQL, a semi-join (`WHERE Id IN (SELECT ... FROM Account)`) cannot query the same sObject type (`Account`) in both the outer and inner selects. Because parent account names are guaranteed to be unique in this org, we can query the child accounts directly, traverse up to `Parent.Name`, and use `GROUP BY` to deduplicate the parent accounts.

```soql
SELECT Parent.Name Name
FROM Account
WHERE BillingCountry = 'Germany' AND ParentId != NULL
GROUP BY Parent.Name
```
